title: The affine etale generator separates sheaf maps
statement: For any scheme X in universe u, the concretely constructed sheaf G_X [def-sc-etale-small-generator] is a separator in the category of AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}-valued sheaves on X_et: two maps F to H agreeing after precomposition with every map G_X to F are equal.

source.place: Sheafified free abelian representables; see also Tag 03EW (3) and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Generator.Sheaf.

proof.text: The lifted integer group separates abelian-group maps: a homomorphism from it associated with an element x sends 1 to x, so equality after all such homomorphisms gives componentwise equality. This is proved by the private integer_isSeparator helper in Lean.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isSeparator on the u-small model to the constant Unit-indexed family consisting of the lifted integer group. The free-Yoneda and sheafification adjunctions identify maps from each free sheaf with sections, and the coproduct separates maps. Transport the separator property along each of the two site equivalences with IsSeparator.of_equivalence; the resulting sheaf is exactly the constructed G_X.

proof_origin.place: Free abelian representable sheaves; universe-explicit affine-model construction using Mathlib.
